backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profile storage with role-based access control, including authenticated user and admin permissions. Exposes profile CRUD queries, admin-only deployment check, and a public health check.
feature_evidence.json: Machine-readable report documenting implemented login phone-input features, their related files, dependencies, test IDs, and confidence levels for verification and audit purposes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Aggregated human-readable summaries of key frontend source files, components, hooks, styles, and pages to provide a high-level architectural and feature overview.
frontend/ADMIN_PANEL_VERIFICATION.md: Step-by-step manual testing checklist for the admin panel, covering authentication, route protection, CRUD flows, animations, background behavior, and error handling.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS base defining luxury-themed design tokens, light/dark mode variables, animations, and consistent styling across the application.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point setting up metadata, fonts, favicon assets, dark mode, and mounting the React application.
frontend/RELEASE_NOTES.md: Detailed release notes describing recent draft versions, highlighting the international phone input, login flow improvements, admin panel features, and QA checklists.
frontend/src/admin/AdminArea.tsx: Admin container that selects and renders the correct admin page based on the current route. It wraps content with admin layout and product state provider.
frontend/src/admin/adminConfig.ts: Defines admin-related constants including a hardcoded admin principal and admin route paths. Used for access control and navigation.
Guards admin routes by checking Internet Identity login state and admin authorization. Redirects unauthorized users to the admin login and blocks rendering until initialization completes.
frontend/src/admin/components/AdminLayou: Provides the admin UI shell with header, sidebar navigation, and logout functionality. Displays the active route and renders child admin content in the main area.
frontend/src/admin/components/ImageDropz: Reusable drag-and-drop image uploader for admin product images with preview and removal support. Manages local blob URLs and validates image file types.
frontend/src/admin/components/ProductFor: Form component for creating and editing products, including validation, variants, categories, pricing, and image uploads. Submits structured product data back to the admin state layer.
frontend/src/admin/hooks/useAdminSaveFee: Custom hook that triggers toast notifications and temporary save animations after admin save actions. Respects reduced-motion preferences when choosing animation timing.
Admin dashboard page showing high-level catalog metrics derived from in-memory product state. Contains placeholder cards and explanatory notes about the non-persistent data model.
Admin login page that authenticates via Internet Identity, checks admin access, and conditionally navigates to the admin dashboard or shows access/login errors.
frontend/src/admin/pages/AdminProductsPa: Admin UI for managing products in in-memory state, supporting create, edit, and delete actions with dialogs, feedback animations, and category display.
frontend/src/admin/state/AdminProductsPr: React context provider that stores admin products in local component state and exposes CRUD operations for products.
frontend/src/admin/types.ts: TypeScript interfaces defining admin product models, product images, and form data shapes used across the admin area.
frontend/src/admin/utils/adminGuard.ts: Utility that determines whether the current authenticated principal has admin access based on login state and a configured admin principal.
frontend/src/admin/utils/principalFormat: Helper function to shorten and format long Internet Identity principal strings for display.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root SPA component that handles theme setup and client-side routing for storefront, admin, login, and dashboard views using pathname checks. It wires global providers, layout elements, and access protection for admin and authenticated pages.
frontend/src/assets/branding.ts: Centralized constants for brand assets such as logo, favicon, bot avatar paths, and the brand name.
frontend/src/commerce/CommerceProvider.t: Commerce context provider that manages a shopping cart persisted to localStorage, with helpers for cart totals, item counts, and cart mutations.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthErrorAl: Renders a destructive alert showing an authentication error message when an Error object is provided. Uses shared Alert UI components and an icon for visual emphasis.
frontend/src/components/auth/Internation: Provides an international phone number input with country selector, search, validation on blur, and formatted numeric input handling. Integrates country data, popover-based selection, and optional validation callbacks.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProtectedRo: Guards routes by redirecting unauthenticated users to the login page while setting a flash message and return path. Renders children only when authentication state is valid.
frontend/src/components/banarasi/Banaras: Displays a modal overlay with a carousel of Banarasi products for a selected category, including quick view and detail view flows. Updates page metadata dynamically and respects reduced-motion preferences.
Renders the main Banarasi saree collections showcase page with grouped product sections, ambient visuals, and dynamic metadata. Manages quick view and product detail modals across categories.

Represents an individual Banarasi category section with scroll-reveal animation, carousel-based product browsing, and optional autoplay. Handles reduced-motion preferences and exposes callbacks for quick and detailed product views.

Renders a bottom overlay with quick details for a Banarasi product, including colors, fabric, price, rating, and actions like share and add to cart, using dummy product data. Visibility depends on product category and an isVisible flag.

Creates a full-screen canvas-based ambient pearl shimmer animation for the Banarasi showcase, respecting reduced-motion preferences. Falls back to a static gradient background when animations are disabled.
Provides a skeleton loading UI for Banarasi product cards, mimicking image, text, price, and action layouts while data loads.
frontend/src/components/cart/CartPanel.t: Displays cart contents with quantity controls, removal actions, totals, and an empty-cart state, using commerce hooks and dummy product data. Handles checkout initiation with authentication checks.
frontend/src/components/cart/CartSheet.t: Wraps the CartPanel inside a right-side sheet component with a styled header, controlling open/close state and checkout flow.
frontend/src/components/checkout/Checkou: Implements the checkout form for contact and shipping details, shows an order summary from the cart, and triggers the checkout mutation on submit.
Manages the checkout sheet state, switching between the checkout form and a success screen once an order ID is returned.
Shows an order confirmation screen with order ID and a continue shopping button, optionally enhanced with motion effects.
frontend/src/components/CinematicHeroSli: Single slide component for a cinematic hero section, rendering layered parallax visuals, animated text, and respecting reduced-motion preferences.
Full-screen hero slider that cycles through cinematic slides with autoplay, swipe and arrow navigation, transitions, and reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand description, quick anchor links, and a copyright line showing the current year and an external credit link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements the main sticky site header with branding, navigation links, cart/checkout controls, authentication actions, and responsive mobile behavior, hidden on admin routes.
frontend/src/components/hero/GoldWaveLay: Renders animated gold wave effects on a canvas for hero slides, responding to active state, slide index, and reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/hero/GoldWaveWip: Displays a gold gradient wipe overlay during slide transitions, with alternate animations for reduced-motion users.
frontend/src/components/hero/PearlShimme: Canvas-based React component that renders animated pearl-like shimmer particles for the hero section, respecting reduced-motion preferences and slide activity.
frontend/src/components/hero/ProductSilh: Renders decorative animated circular silhouette elements layered in the hero background, with transitions disabled or reduced when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/hero/RollerTagli: Interactive tagline component that animates individual letters on hover or tap with shimmer and underline effects, adapting behavior for touch devices and reduced motion.
frontend/src/components/hero/ScrollHintA: Displays a scroll hint link with text and a bouncing chevron icon that links to the collections section and respects reduced-motion settings.
frontend/src/components/LetterRevealText: Displays animated text that reveals characters one by one when active, respecting the user’s reduced motion preference.
Draws an animated ocean-themed canvas background with noise-based waves, foam particles, mouse/scroll interaction, and reduced-motion support.
frontend/src/components/product/ImageZoo: Product image gallery with hover-based zoom, thumbnail navigation, and next/previous controls, disabling zoom effects when reduced motion is preferred.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders an interactive product card with add-to-cart, wishlist, quick view, and navigation logic, including animations, auth checks, and duplicate prevention.
frontend/src/components/QuickViewSheet.t: Provides a slide-in sheet to quickly view product details and add items to the cart with animations, auth enforcement, and duplicate handling.
frontend/src/components/raahi/raahiRespo: Rule-based response engine for the RaaHi chatbot that maps keyword groups to predefined friendly responses without using an external AI model.
Implements a floating chat widget for the RaaHi assistant with session-based auto-greeting, message handling, typing simulation, and reduced-motion support. Manages chat UI state, scrolling, and generates canned bot responses.
frontend/src/components/SangamBackground: This file is currently empty and contains no implementation.
frontend/src/data/banarasiCategories.ts: Defines the BanarasiCategory interface and a static registry of creative Banarasi saree collection categories with metadata like patterns, color families, and occasions.
frontend/src/data/banarasiGrouping.ts: Provides a deterministic client-side utility that groups Banarasi products into predefined categories using heuristic checks on names, patterns, and color attributes.
frontend/src/data/dummyProducts.ts: Defines the DummyProduct interface and helpers to generate a large curated catalog of Banarasi and related apparel with images, pricing, stock, ratings, and rich metadata for frontend display.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches a backend actor using React Query, handling authenticated vs anonymous identities and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddToCartAnimation: Provides an animate function that plays a flying cloth-like animation from a source element to the cart button, respecting reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuthRedirect.ts: Exposes a requireAuth helper that redirects unauthenticated users to login while setting a flash message and return path.
frontend/src/hooks/useCinematicSlider.ts: Manages state and interactions for a cinematic slider with autoplay, pause/resume, navigation, and pointer-based swipe gestures.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommerce.ts: Simple hook that accesses the CommerceContext and enforces usage within the CommerceProvider.
frontend/src/hooks/useDynamicMetadata.ts: Updates document title and meta description dynamically and restores original values on unmount.
frontend/src/hooks/useGoldRipple.ts: Creates a gold ripple click/touch effect on elements with animation duration adjusted for reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useInfiniteScroll.ts: Implements infinite scrolling using an IntersectionObserver sentinel to trigger loading more content when nearing the viewport.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context, provider, and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient configuration.
Custom hook that syncs React state with localStorage, supporting lazy initialization and functional updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useMousePosition.ts: Tracks and returns the current mouse cursor position using a window mousemove listener.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Detects and subscribes to the user's prefers-reduced-motion media query and exposes it as a boolean.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for products, cart, and checkout using dummy data and a local commerce store, including mutations for cart operations and simulated checkout.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollReveal.ts: Provides hooks to reveal elements on scroll using IntersectionObserver, with support for reduced motion and staggered animation delays.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpaLocation.ts: Implements a lightweight SPA location and navigation hook using the History API, popstate events, and a custom navigation event.
frontend/src/hooks/useStorefrontAuth.ts: Manages storefront authentication state via OTP sessions and Internet Identity, including localStorage-backed flash messages, return paths, and OTP lockout logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useWishlist.ts: Implements a wishlist hook backed by localStorage with helpers to add, remove, toggle, and clear product IDs.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets up Tailwind CSS base, dark and light theme design tokens, global typography, and custom utilities for layout, effects, and premium UI styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app by rendering App with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loading global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutSection.tsx: Renders an animated About section with scroll-reveal effects, highlighting brand values and narrative content using icon cards.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutSection.tsx: Displays a secure checkout marketing section with scroll-reveal animations, feature highlights, and a call-to-action button.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Implements the user dashboard with tabs for profile, orders, and address management, including add/edit/delete addresses and logout handling via storefront auth.
frontend/src/pages/FaqSection.tsx: Renders a FAQ section using an accordion with scroll-reveal animations, displaying a static list of common questions and answers.
frontend/src/pages/HomeSection.tsx: Defines the home hero section that fills the viewport and renders the CinematicHeroSlider component.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Implements a phone-based login flow with OTP generation/verification, validation, lockout handling, and optional Internet Identity login.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailView.tsx: Displays a modal-style product detail view with image gallery, pricing, quantity selection, and add-to-cart logic with auth checks and metadata updates.
frontend/src/pages/ProductSection.tsx: Shows a marketing section highlighting key product features (quality, authenticity, delivery, packaging) with scroll-reveal animations.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Renders the main products listing with a Banarasi showcase, masonry grid of products, quick/detail views, and infinite scroll loading.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines core frontend TypeScript interfaces for products, cart, orders, and extended dummy-commerce product attributes.
frontend/src/utils/detectCountryFromLoca: Detects the user’s country using the Intl time zone API or browser language and returns matching phone country data, defaulting to India if detection fails or is unsupported.
frontend/src/utils/phoneCountries.ts: Defines a curated list of supported countries with ISO codes, dial codes, flags, and formats, plus helpers to look up countries by code or dial code.
frontend/src/utils/phoneValidation.ts: Implements country-specific phone number validation rules, producing E.164 formatted numbers on success and user-friendly error messages on failure.
frontend/src/utils/premiumToasts.ts: Wraps the Sonner toast API to display styled premium notifications with variants for success, error, info, and duplicate actions.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to read URL parameters from query strings or hash routes, persist them in sessionStorage, and safely clear sensitive params.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending fonts, colors, shadows, animations, and OKLCH-based design tokens for the app’s luxury dark theme.
project_state.json: High-level snapshot of the project architecture, features, and versions, documenting the current frontend-first e-commerce SPA state and implemented capabilities.
